title: Site Standards and Cure Periods, Community Rules & Site Care
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, the following site standards and cure periods apply on every home site, whatever plan is in force. They are the same on all six plans: Self-Maintained Site, Lawn Mowing Plan, Lawn & Trim Plan, Full Lawn Care Plan, Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan and Complete Site Care Plan.

## Site standards

| Standard | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Grass height above which a site breaches the lawn rule | 6 inches |
| Hours after snowfall ends within which a resident responsible for their own snow removal must clear walks and the driveway apron | 24 hours |
| Notices in the same rule class within the window at which the matter is referred to the community manager for lease enforcement | 3 notices |

## Cure period by rule class

The cure period is the number of calendar days after a violation notice within which the violation must be cured.

| Rule class | Cure period (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Lawn and landscaping | 7 |
| Debris and storage | 7 |
| Home exterior | 30 |
| Vehicles and parking | 7 |
| Pets | 7 |
| Snow and ice | 1 |
| Unapproved structure | 30 |

## Reading the table

- **Hypothetical illustration.** Grass measured at 6 inches is at the limit and does not breach the lawn rule; grass measured above 6 inches does.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A notice in the home exterior class allows 30 calendar days to cure; a notice in the snow and ice class allows 1.
- The cure periods do not vary by plan: a lawn and landscaping notice carries the same 7-day period on the Self-Maintained Site as on the Complete Site Care Plan.
